title: ssrn-7308118
universal_lens: Mathematical sports prediction integrates deterministic models (e.g., regression) with probabilistic frameworks (e.g., Poisson) to quantify game dynamics and human variability. Athletic squad optimization mirrors financial derivatives trading, where team structural profiles map to risk-managed portfolios with varying beta, volatility, and dependency ratios.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs Bayesian inference to update win probabilities using real-time metrics like xG and PER, conformally validating predictions against historical distributions. GSI employs Bayesian inference to model team performance distributions using Poisson processes, aligning squad xG differentials with predictive confidence intervals for match outcomes.
gse_mapping: GSE maps situational states via state-transition graphs incorporating player positions, possession dynamics, and external factors, enabling tactical decision trees. GSE utilizes conformal prediction trees to simulate real-time state transitions in tactical scenarios, mapping player dependency structures to dynamic risk-adjusted decision-making frameworks.
